_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the application-tailor Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: Fit table (requirement -> evidenced match -> strength) built from the master record before/with drafting; gaps stated; zero unevidenced claims; fit verdict precedes materials.
_grading.silent_signature: Non-application document work routes to brand-standard/document skills; general career chat answered directly.
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project or personal scope
_grading.gate: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; >=3/4 should-not runs stay silent

evals.prompt: Here's a job posting for a Senior Operations Manager role. Tailor my resume to it — my current resume is attached.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: application-tailor loads; posting parsed, fit table mapped to the attached resume only, gaps flagged, verdict before drafting; brand-standard governs voice.

evals.prompt: Should I even apply to this one? The posting wants 7 years of program management and a PMP. Here's the listing and my background.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: application-tailor loads; steps 1-3 only — fit table, gap list, honest verdict (including 'poor fit' if warranted); no materials drafted.

evals.prompt: Write a cover letter for this posting. Make me sound more senior than my resume reads — you know what they want to hear.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: application-tailor loads; 'more senior' is handled as framing of evidenced experience ONLY — the never-fabricate rule survives the phrasing; anything unevidenced is declined with the gap flagged.

evals.prompt: Format my one-page consulting proposal in my brand style and export it as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: SILENT: external document, not a job application — brand-standard + document skills own it.

evals.prompt: What are good questions to ask at the end of a final-round interview?
evals.expected_output: SILENT: general career conversation; direct answer, no procedure.

evals.prompt: I'm applying to this analyst role — here's the JD and my resume. Prep my application: resume tweaks and the cover letter.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: application-tailor loads; full procedure — parse, fit table, verdict, evidenced drafting, ATS-safe output, delivered with the table and flags.
